meta.title: DNS Configuration Inventory
meta.scope: Selected domain controllers in one explicit domain
meta.notice: SAMPLE DATA. Fictional DC DNS configuration; no infrastructure was contacted.
limitations: The target list contains only DCs discovered in the explicitly supplied domain; non-DC DNS servers and child domains are not auto-enumerated.
Client adapter resolvers, server forwarders and conditional forwarders are separate datasets.
Zone observations repeat per server. Zone names across DCs are not merged into a claimed unique/consistent configuration.
Per-zone aging, delegation and scope reads are limited to Primary zones in the default virtualization instance; excluded types are listed as NotAttempted. Delegation reads use the default zone scope.
One failed/unsupported zone query leaves other successful rows intact; category status becomes Partial. See Per-zone collection for details.
An absent DNS role is NotApplicable; access denial, missing modules and failed queries are not treated as absence.

NS records are read from Primary, Secondary and Stub zones in the default zone scope/virtualization instance. NS address reads use only exact A/AAAA nodes in the most-specific matching hosted Primary/Secondary zone; external targets are not resolved. See per-query outcomes.
No full resource-record dump, resolver probe, scavenging pass, DNS update, cache flush, service change or email is performed. Inventory completeness is not health.
